name: TriasWear
summary: TriasWear is more than just a clothing brand; it’s a personal connection between us and our audience. It’s something we love doing, and I look forward to working on it every day.

name: Flow
summary: Flow helps me see where my money is and how much I can safely spend each paycheck. It’s easy to use, so I can find what I need without searching around.

name: Codepath
summary: Codepath is easy to use and helps you learn web development through hands-on activities, including building portfolio websites. I love that there’s something for you whether you’re just starting or already have experience.

name: Vector Climate
summary: Vector Climate is a website mockup for a fictional HVAC company that shows my attention to detail. I wanted to keep it simple and easy to use, so visitors can find what they need and contact the business.
